summary.method: Read batches 01–06 manifests and visually inspected every ground on three labeled contact sheets; full-size comparisons for forest day, tidal stone, frozen shore, frost vault and ice bank. Compared map-icons-painterly-v1 style guide against the required battlefield camera adaptation. Alpha edge and canvas issues are excluded from style verdicts.
summary.finding: Ground family is already substantially coherent. Preserve distinct coastal wetness, snow/frost, volcanic warmth, night and interior palettes. One ice surface needs softer painted material treatment and quieter center.

items.reason: Broad hand-painted stone and dusty earth, soft upper-left daylight and quiet center; warm forest sunlight remains compatible with diffuse-day styling.
Painterly forest stones retain the same shallow ground plane and clear middle; blue low-key illumination is the intentional night variant.
Soft gray-green stones, subdued mist lighting and unobstructed center match the ground profile.
Painted muddy wheel ruts and subdued paving share the same shallow viewpoint; curved road stays low and leaves a usable combat surface.
Desaturated ochre meadow, worn stones and soft tactile detail match the regional painterly benchmark.
Broad worn gray-tan slabs, restrained seams and quiet center maintain the established matte medieval ground style.
Dark weathered flagstones and dusty ash have restrained highlights and coherent shallow perspective.
Matte charcoal basalt slabs use broad irregular forms and subdued detail; dark regional palette is intentional.
Wet stone has localized soft sheen, broad painterly faces and a subdued clear center; coastal moisture is a justified material variant.
Painted tidal ripples and soft wet-sand reflections retain the low viewpoint and open middle; material sheen is restrained.
Dark olive mud and scattered stones use muted tactile brushwork with a quiet central route.
Moss and earth stay subdued and painterly, with foliage concentrated along the sides.
Broad matte dungeon slabs, soft side illumination and clear center fit the interior variant.
Low gravel and rubble have subdued painted material detail; larger debris remains at the edges.
Cold snow and frost retain soft broad snow forms and a quiet middle; blue-white palette is a deliberate frozen biome difference.
Snow-packed wheel tracks form a broad open lane with painted snowbanks and coherent shallow perspective.
Warm weathered cobbles use broad readable stones and soft light, with no obstructive central prop.
Charcoal paving has restrained ember-colored edge accents and matte painted wear; foundry warmth is intentional.
Dark slabs remain tactile and painterly; small warm perimeter reflections suit the vault interior without overpowering the center.
Subdued wet paving and moss share broad painted material treatment; localized watery highlights suit the flooded interior.
Weathered harbor slabs have restrained wet reflections, subdued green-gray colors and a clear middle.
Painted pavers and low roots retain the shallow ground view; roots stay at the sides and interior color is coherent.
Mossy village cobbles have muted greens and broad hand-painted wear; low repeating stones remain usable under combatants.
Warm dusty flagstones use broad matte faces and soft illumination, compatible with the interior setting.
Frost-lined broad stone slabs keep readable painted faces and shallow perspective; blue frost is the intentional interior material variant.

The central ice plane reads as polished glass with sharp white fracture lines and dense bright crystalline detail across the combat area. This all-over specular treatment is harder and busier than the soft matte painterly ground family, beyond the legitimate cold biome palette.
Snow-covered courtyard slabs preserve broad matte faces and softened frost detail with the shared shallow ground plane.

recommendedReplacements.direction: Retain blue-gray frozen lake and low snowy side banks, wide side-view shallow plane and transparent upper half. Paint ice as weathered frosted matte blue-gray masses with broad subtle texture; restrict a few softened cracks to foreground corners, reduce bright reflective white streaks, and keep middle combat area quiet. Use soft neutral upper-left daylight; preserve cold biome palette.
